Kerala Cleric's Remark on Women Sparks Political Row

A statement by Syed Mohammed Jifri Muthukoya Thangal, a leader of the Samastha Kerala Jamiyyathul Ulama, suggesting women should remain in their homes has ignited a political controversy in Kerala. The cleric reportedly stated that religious scholars should not be attacked for explaining teachings to their followers. Kerala's Chief Minister has criticized the remark, while the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) has adopted a cautious stance. The BJP has also targeted Rahul Gandhi in connection with the controversy.
